correctness.rationale: The finite-support Fourier transform factors into the nonzero-on-a-dense-set unit-cell integral and a Laurent polynomial. Equality of full magnitudes is exactly equality of aperiodic integer autocorrelations. Every normalized three-run support has precisely four cuts among n-1 positions, so the exhaustive checker visits all C(n-1,4) words for each n=5,...,12. It computes full correlation signatures by independent pair enumeration and bitshift intersection, confirms reversal classes 1,3,9,19,38,66,110,170 and distinct signatures 1,3,9,19,38,66,110,169, and isolates exactly two nonreflection words in the one exceptional fiber. A reciprocal-factor identity proves explicit magnitude equality. Limits are n<=12 for lower bound and integer endpoints throughout; no extrapolation from finite to infinite n.

originality.rationale: The first nontrivial Fourier-magnitude collision in the unit-grid three-interval class occurs at span 12 and has a unique unordered fiber of two reversal classes. The closest 2026 source constructs ambiguous examples for three or more general intervals, but its accessible theorems do not assert the optimal integer-grid span or enumerate all first-span ambiguity classes. Existing factor-reversal general theory accounts for the witness but not the explicit cutoff/complete finite classification. Targeted public mathematical-record searches yielded no covering statement. Residual risks are recorded.

The 2017 and 1982 papers were not available for full-text inspection; only preview or descriptions could be compared.

value.rationale: General three-interval Fourier phase ambiguity exists, but the first integer-grid aperture complexity at which it occurs is a motivated sharp invariant in discrete binary imaging. Determining that 12 cells are necessary and sufficient, with exactly one unordered nontrivial collision up to symmetries, gives a complete first-obstruction classification rather than one arbitrary witness or a textbook formula. It distinguishes all smaller configurations from the first genuine phase-ambiguous design. No claim of noise stability or arbitrary-real endpoint uniqueness is made.
